decision: Static evidence-linked scene first; precomputed lawful scene with supporting originals/cameras may qualify viewing/reuse before new reconstruction.

candidate_stack.candidate: gsplat; Splatfacto wrapper only where justified
self-hosted SuperSplat Viewer/PlayCanvas under existing Control Room access
separately validated geometry; evaluate 2DGS/GOF only if required
full-fidelity master plus a qualified versioned SOG or SPZ derivative

job_rules: Use one accountable executor and durable intent before consequential submission.
Preserve actual submitted/result IDs; do not invent cross-chat dispatch.
A cancel request is distinct from confirmed termination.
An in-memory F2 hold is not durable cross-process reconciliation.
No retry solely because a response or tool receipt is missing.

acceptance_cases.name: Rights and retained originals
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Original images/cameras/models have explicit access, permitted use and redistribution scope; manifest refers to actual retrievable bytes.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Unknown rights or absent required source bytes block full evidence admission.

acceptance_cases.name: Pose and coordinate integrity
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Known control points project consistently; conversions record handedness, quaternion order, intrinsics/distortion and normalization.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Reject ambiguous pose convention; never silently reinterpret coordinates.

acceptance_cases.name: Scale gate
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Metric output has independent scale evidence, units, calibrated geometry and uncertainty.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Unknown scale produces no real-world distance claim.

acceptance_cases.name: Reproducible view bundle
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Actual render bytes and exact input/camera/renderer configuration retained; comparison uses justified tolerances.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: An attractive screenshot without lineage is not accepted view evidence.

acceptance_cases.name: Supported question
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Question answer cites permitted original views and correctly scoped scene/region IDs.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Novel-view completion alone cannot establish an observed fact.

acceptance_cases.name: Unsupported question
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Missing/occluded evidence produces a justified insufficient-evidence result.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: No invented hidden-side geometry, labels, identity or future motion.

acceptance_cases.name: Second real consumer
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Another actual authorized role retrieves the exact accepted scene/method, applies it and returns a reviewed result.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Fixture roles, a shared URL and copied narrative do not pass.

acceptance_cases.name: Appearance evaluation
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Held-out images/split/camera-estimation protocol fixed; report metrics and visual failure cases.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Near-duplicate leakage or changed denominators prevent fair comparison.

acceptance_cases.name: Derivative and codec compatibility
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Master and encoded derivative compared at fixed views; decoder/version/SH/axis/LOD preserved.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Do not label quantized data lossless or assume extension-wide compatibility.

acceptance_cases.name: Performance and cost
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Report device/runtime/resolution/count, cold load, p50/p95 frame times, CPU/GPU memory and actual time/cost.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: No borrowing published fps, VRAM or cost as measured project results.

acceptance_cases.name: Access and revocation
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Enforce current record policy on originals, derived renders, cached contexts and secondary consumers.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Denied access returns no restricted scene or image bytes.

acceptance_cases.name: Interrupted-operation recovery
acceptance_cases.pass_requires: Durable operation/receipt plus status reconciliation survives an interrupted return without duplicate effects.
acceptance_cases.failure_boundary: Timeout or missing chat is not confirmed cancellation or permission to retry.

proposed_performance_target.conditions: Named device, resolution, asset and renderer. Cold load separate; no measured pass asserted.

team_boundary: Head Chef coordinates; Codex executes only a scoped work order; specialists own findings; Grok evidence stays attributed; Worker5 reports accepted results; Claude librarian remains a proposed held role.
publication_rule: Use existing website content path and verify actual URL/version; repository saving is not website deployment or team consumption.
next_action: After current trusted-return review consumption, name one lawful scene and required runtime/access/compute scope; perform no new training from this reference.
